body:
Enabling Best DVB-T Signal Reception, Even in Fringe Areas

Digital television is sweeping Germany and Europe. Nonetheless, terrestrial DVB signal reception remains weak in some fringe areas. Reception quality depends to a large extent on an antenna’s quality. To improve TV reception, the Nettetal-based Multmedia company TerraTec Electronic is bringing to market an active in-house antenna for DVB-T reception. The newly developed LRR technology - LRR stands for Long Range Reception - clearly improves range and signal quality. The same goes for DAB. Priced at 29.99 euros, Cinergy Antenna One will be available from April.

LRR technology delivers TV signals to regions that so far have needed an outside antenna. Its reception power is comparable to a rooftop antenna’s. Cinergy Antenna One comes with an amp (18dB) that is low in noise and distortion, and resistant to interference signals. The antenna is powered via the USB interface or a DVB-T-receiver providing phantom power.

Cinergy Antenna One works with all TerraTec DVB-T products, as well as with other vendors’ DVB-T receivers, such as settop boxes.

The facts at a glance:

• Compact, active indoor aerial

• Receives DVB-T and DAB

• Improved range and reception quality
